Auditor's Office
The Marshall County Auditor serves as the County Fiscal Officer and is constitutionally limited to serving no more than 8 years within a 12-year time span. Central to nearly all financial and administrative actions, the Auditor’s office is widely considered the “hub” of county government. While established in the Indiana Constitution , the specific duties of the role are defined under IC 36-2-9.
The core responsibilities and essential functions of the county auditor include, but are not limited to, the following:
• Property Tax Calculation – computes final property tax liabilities based on local assessments provided by the Assessor
• Deductions & Credits – manages and applies property tax deductions and credits enacted by the Indiana General Assembly
• Deed Processing – processes all real estate deed transfers, including standard transfers, property splits, and plot combinations
• Property Record Keeping – acts as the county’s official record keeper for real property tax ownership
• Tax Distribution – collects and semi-annually distributes property taxes to all underlying units of government in Marshall County
• Local Tax Management – collects and monthly disburses local income tax, financial institution tax, and commercial vehicle tax
• Annual Budgeting – coordinates annual budget preparation and formal submission for county departments.
• Expense Auditing – reviews and process all internal department claims for county expenses prior to payment
• Payroll & Benefits – manages payroll administration and benefits for all Marshall County government employees
• Commissioner and Council Board Secretary – serves as the official secretary and permanent record keeper of minutes for the Board of County Commissioners and the County Council
• State Reporting – submits the Annual Financial Report, 100R Certification of Employee Compensation, Debt Management Reports, Certified Net Assessed Value, County Abstract, Tax Duplicate Date, Form 22 for Semi-Annual Settlement Distribution via Indiana’s Transparency portal Gateway.
